versions.changelog:
- Initial release of gtd-pkm skill.
- Helps users audit, co-create, phase-in, and continually optimize a GTD-based personal knowledge management (PKM) system with OpenClaw.
- Supports new setups, existing library refactoring, directory/tag strategies, and automation design for AGENTS.md, HEARTBEAT.md, TODO, etc.
- Emphasizes gradual implementation, user collaboration, and iterative improvement—never a one-off initialization.
- Includes clear principles for directory/tag usage, automation, audit tools, and script usage safety boundaries.
